formulas.formula: Price every bake right and see what your bakery really earns.
Setup: your bakery name, the year, what your time is worth, oven/overhead per batch, card fee, target margin and a monthly goal.
Pantry: each ingredient with the package size, unit and price you pay.
Recipes: list each ingredient a recipe uses and how much (same unit as the Pantry).
Products: one row per recipe with how many it makes, how long it takes and your price. See the true cost and the price you should charge.
Orders and Expenses: log sales and costs. Monthly, Product Stats and Dashboard show your real profit.
The recipe name on Recipes must match the product name on Products, and ingredient names must match the Pantry.
Labor is counted at your hourly rate, so profit means after paying yourself.
Oven power, water and wear. A small amount per batch adds up.
Products shows Too low when your price is under the price for your target margin.
Red = priced too low, unpaid or a typo.

What your baking time is worth.
Profit you want after all costs.
What you buy. Use grams, ml or each (eggs, lemons). Recipes use the same unit.
One row per ingredient in a recipe. Recipe names must match Products; ingredients must match the Pantry.
Profit each = your price minus true cost and the card fee. Price for target margin covers everything plus your margin.
Blank Price = your price on Products. Cost = true cost each (ingredients, your time, overhead, box) x qty.
Costs not inside a recipe: equipment, permits, marketing. Ingredients are already counted in each order's cost.
